entry.title: Updated: dsh-ds-attach
entry.summary: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content. Exact install spec: github:wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
